# netgear_ssid (Resource)

Manages one of the SSID slots of the access point. The SSID is shared by the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz radios and can be enabled per radio.

The slots always exist on the device, so creating this resource takes over the slot and destroying it only disables the SSID on both radios (the other settings are left as they are).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# WPA2/WPA3-Personal SSID on both radios.
resource "netgear_ssid" "office" {
  slot          = 1
  ssid          = "office"
  passphrase    = var.office_passphrase
  band_steering = true
}

# Guest SSID on a VLAN, isolated clients, 2.4 GHz only.
resource "netgear_ssid" "guest" {
  slot             = 2
  ssid             = "guest"
  enabled_5g       = false
  security         = "psk2"
  passphrase       = var.guest_passphrase
  vlan_id          = 20
  client_isolation = true
}

# WPA3-Enterprise SSID with RADIUS authentication.
resource "netgear_ssid" "corp" {
  slot          = 3
  ssid          = "corp"
  security      = "wpa3"
  radius_server = "192.0.2.10"
  radius_secret = var.radius_secret
  hidden        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slot` (Number) SSID slot number (`1`-`4`), as listed in the web UI.
- `ssid` (String) Network name (1-32 characters).

### Optional

- `accounting_enabled` (Boolean) Enable RADIUS accounting. Defaults to `false`.
- `accounting_interval` (Number) Interim accounting update interval in seconds (`60`-`600`). Defaults to `600`.
- `accounting_port` (Number) RADIUS accounting server port. Defaults to `1813`.
- `accounting_secret` (String, Sensitive) RADIUS accounting shared secret. Required when `accounting_enabled` is `true`.
- `accounting_server` (String) RADIUS accounting server address. Required when `accounting_enabled` is `true`.
- `band_steering` (Boolean) Steer dual band clients to the 5 GHz radio. Requires `enabled_2g` and `enabled_5g` to be `true`. Defaults to `false`.
- `client_isolation` (Boolean) Prevent wireless clients of this SSID from communicating with each other. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled_2g` (Boolean) Broadcast the SSID on the 2.4 GHz radio. Defaults to `true`.
- `enabled_5g` (Boolean) Broadcast the SSID on the 5 GHz radio. Defaults to `true`.
- `fast_roaming` (Boolean) Enable fast roaming (802.11r). Defaults to `false`.
- `group_rekey_interval` (Number) WPA group key update interval in seconds (`30`-`3600`, `0` disables). Defaults to `3600`.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Hide the SSID (do not broadcast it). Defaults to `false`.
- `mac_addresses` (Set of String) Client MAC addresses for the MAC filter, in lower case (e.g. `aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff`). Up to 64 entries. Required when `mac_filter` is not `disabled`.
- `mac_filter` (String) MAC address filter mode: `disabled`, `allow` (only listed clients may connect) or `deny` (listed clients are rejected). Defaults to `disabled`.
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive) Pre-shared key (8-63 printable ASCII characters or 64 hex digits). Required for the personal security modes.
- `radius_port` (Number) RADIUS authentication server port. Defaults to `1812`.
- `radius_secret` (String, Sensitive) RADIUS shared secret (1-64 characters). Required for the enterprise security modes.
- `radius_server` (String) RADIUS authentication server address. Required for the enterprise security modes.
- `security` (String) Security mode. One of `none`, `owe` (Enhanced Open), `psk2` (WPA2-Personal), `sae` (WPA3-Personal), `sae-mixed` (WPA2/WPA3-Personal), `wpa2` (WPA2-Enterprise), `wpa3-mixed` (WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise), `wpa3` (WPA3-Enterprise). Defaults to `sae-mixed`.
- `vlan_id` (Number) Enable VLAN isolation and tag the traffic of this SSID with the given VLAN ID (`1`-`4094`). When omitted, VLAN isolation is disabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The slot number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# SSID slots are imported by their slot number (1-4).
terraform import netgear_ssid.office 1
```
